svg.text: Creatures: study, not decided (#1158). True size at the default camera, then 4x. Ally, foe, dead; a player beside them.
A: a silhouette per family (wolf teardrop, minion and horror spiked, spirit a ringed wisp)
B: a ghost body: a team outline round a dim fill, a kind glyph inside
C: a hexagon plate for every creature, the glyph cut out of it
Order in every row: wolf (pet), bone minion, bone horror, spirit; then player ally, player foe. Dead: dashed outline in dead, no fill (a player corpse is a hollow solid circle).
